facts.value: Forwards the fighter object and ftCo_80090984 to ft_8008370C. Its inline helper transfers fighter/collision positions, selects a stage query using facing, ledge cooldown and x2224_b2, then copies the resolved position back. It reports true only when the query succeeds and ft_80081A00 returns false. A true combined result invokes ftCo_80090984, which tries ftCo_80098928, then ftCo_8009872C, then ftCo_80097D40. A false combined result reaches wall-jump and ledge checks.

The canonical helper suppresses the raw result via ft_80081A00 but then runs the outer false-result wall/ledge path. Preserve this exact control flow.
